title: Grateful Dead Live at Catholic Youth Center on 1971-04-13

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a high‑energy set featuring a standout Bobby McGee and Pigpen’s scorching harp on Big Boss Man.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the crystal‑clear soundboard recording and the inspired performances, singling out a superb rendition of Bobby McGee and Pigpen’s hot harmonica work on Big Boss Man. The show is described as a must‑hear gem with high energy throughout, making it one of the best 1971 recordings available.

ai_rating.rationale: Two detailed 5‑star reviews praise both the musical performance and the audio fidelity, indicating an exceptional show with excellent soundboard quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the recording as crisp, clear and excellent; no drop‑outs or mix issues are mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Tight and energetic flow throughout the set, highlighted by strong song transitions.

band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen’s harmonica (harp) shines on 'Big Boss Man'.
